summary_1line: Drona and Dhrishtadyumna duel fiercely until Bhima intervenes; Bhima then devastates the Kalinga army in a brutal rampage across the battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dhrishtadyumna rushes at Drona with shield and scimitar like a lion charging an enraged elephant while arrows rain around them.
Bhima leaps onto a war elephant using its tusks, then splits the Kalinga prince Bhanumat in half with a massive sword.
Amid heaps of slain elephants and shattered weapons, Bhima whirls his sword like a wheel of fire while terrified soldiers flee.
